description: This file contains the definition of the 'Category' model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods to interact with category-related data in the database, including retrieving categories, filters, and layout information.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A model class for handling category data operations such as retrieving categories, filters, and layout IDs in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific category by its ID, including descriptions and status.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories under a specified parent category, ordered by sort order and name.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves filter groups and filters associated with a specific category.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific category for the current store setup.
